## Thancrus (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
LE Medium aberration (zoanoid)  
**Init** +13; **Senses** blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., Perception +25  


**Defense**


**AC** 29, touch 20, flat-footed 19 (+9 Dex, +1 dodge, +9 natural)  
**hp** 144 (17d8+68)  
**Fort** +12, **Ref** +14, **Will** +10  
**Resist** fire 10; **SR** 23  
**Defensive Abilities** improved evasion, zoanoid saves  


**Offense**


**Speed** 80 ft., blinding speed  
**Melee** 4 armblades +22 (1d8+9/17-20 plus 1d6 sonic)  
**Special Attacks** armblades, high frequency blades, rapid strikes  


**Statistics**


**Str** 19, **Dex** 29, **Con** 18, **Int** 13, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +21 (+23 sunder); **CMD** 36 (38 vs. sunder)  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Bleeding Critical, Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Critical (armblade), Improved Sunder, Iron Will, [Weapon Focus (armblade)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Agile Maneuvers and Weapon Finesse are one feat, Weapon Finesse; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (armblade), Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +29 (+49 when jumping), Climb +24, Perception +27, Sense Motive +27, Stealth +29; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +4 Sense Motive  
**Languages** Common, Zern  
**SQ** alter ego (Small or Medium humanoid, alter self)  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any land or underground  
**Organization** solitary or squad (2-5)  
**Treasure** incidental  


**Special Abilities**


**Alter Ego (Su)** A thancrus can assume the form of a specific Small or Medium humanoid. This functions as the change shape special quality, except that the thancrus cannot choose the form it assumes.  

**Armblades (Ex)** A thancrus’ armblades are treated as primary natural weapons that deal slashing damage and threaten a critical hit on a roll of 19-20. A thancrus can modify its damage dealt with its armblades with Dexterity.  

**Blinding Speed (Ex)** Three times per day, a thancrus can move its speed as a swift action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.  

**High Frequency Blades (Su)** A thancrus’ blades vibrate at incredible speeds. It deals an extra 1d6 points of sonic damage with each attack, and it ignores the first 10 points of damage reduction or hardness when attacking a creature or object.  

**Rapid Strikes (Ex)** A thancrus can attack twice with its armblades as a standard action, and four times as a full attack action.  

**Zoanoid Saves (Ex)** A thancrus treats Fortitude as its good save and Will as a poor save.
